label: Audience & Focus Group Simulator
description: Simulate structured audience reactions to creative content by testing against configurable reader/viewer personas — emotional impact, engagement, cultural resonance, and marketability.

claudeKnowledge.description: Audience psychology, reader response theory, market demographics, genre readership, emotional engagement patterns, focus group methodology

guidedInputs.label: Primary Target Audience
guidedInputs.placeholder: Describe your target audience: age range, gender, interests, media habits, cultural background, sophistication level, e.g. 'Women 25-45, literary fiction readers, enjoy character-driven drama, Scandinavian crime fans'...

guidedInputs.label: Additional Audience Segments to Test
guidedInputs.placeholder: List other audience segments you want reaction from, e.g. 'Young adult (16-24)', 'Non-English-speaking markets', 'Genre newcomers'...

guidedInputs.label: Content to Test
guidedInputs.placeholder: Paste the creative content to be tested...

guidedInputs.label: Competitive Context (optional)
guidedInputs.placeholder: Name comparable titles in your genre — helps calibrate the simulated reactions against market expectations...
